lines.text: David prays for God to hear him because the voice of the enemy has made his heart pound with terror.
David wishes for wings like a dove so he could fly to the temple and find rest.
David asks the Lord to confuse their speech because he sees violence and strife in the city.
The one who turned on David is not an enemy but his close brother, who once walked with him into God's house.
David calls to God morning, noon, and night, and says to cast your burden upon the LORD, who sustains the righteous.
